items.text: bill galat hai
zyada charge hua
monthly bill check karo

items.context: What issue are you facing with your bill?
items.text: paise jyada kaate hai

items.context: Can you tell me more about the incorrect charge?
items.text: maine use nahi kiya

items.context: Is your plan reflecting correctly on the bill?
items.text: meri plan change nahi hui
mera bill mein kuch zyada paise kata hai
maine last mahine extra call nahi kiye the
kya aap meri last bill ki detail de sakte ho
uss din to main ghar par tha phone use nahi kiya
yesterday nahi Monday ko mera bill zyada aaya hai
kya ye possible hai ki galti ho gayi ho billing mein
please check kar lo mera data charge sahi nahi lagta

items.context: How can I assist you with your bill today?
items.text: mai dekh rahi hu ki mera postpaid bill galat hai

items.context: Have you noticed any unusual charges on your recent bills?
items.text: last month ka bill zyada aaya hai usme ek baar check karna

items.context: Can you specify which charge seems incorrect to you?
items.text: kya aap bata sakte ho ki ye charge kis cheez ka hai

items.context: Is your current plan updated as per your request?
items.text: mujhe lagta hai ki plan change hua nahi mera phone ka

items.context: Are all your calls and messages showing correctly on the bill?
items.text: maine kal jo calls ki thi wo bill mein nahi dikh rahi hain
maine dekha ki mera phone ka bill faisla nahi ho raha hai theek se aur usmein kuch paise jo jyada kata hua hai mujhe samajh nahi aa raha
last month ka bill mein extra 200 rupees ka charge hai jo maine use nahi kiya phone pe toh please is baare mein verify kar lo
kya aap bata sakte ho ki mera data usage jyada kyu hai bill mein jabki maine waise data ka use nahi kiya

items.context: Can you describe the issue you are facing with your postpaid bill?
items.text: maine kai baar phone bills check kiye hain aur lagta hai ki har mahine kuch na kuch extra charge hote hain jise main samajh nahi pa raha

items.context: What would you like us to do after reviewing your bill concerns?
items.text: kya aap mujhe mera recent bill update kar ke dekh sakte ho kyunki mujhe lag raha hai ki ismein galtiyan hain aur main confuse ho gaya hu

items.context: Could you specify the discrepancies you found in your latest bill?
items.text: main ne kaha tha ki mera plan 299 rupees ka hai lekin bill mein 499 rupees ka paise kata gaya hai mujhe batao iska reason kya hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: bill_dispute - says a postpaid bill or charge is wrong
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
